tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search GunPartPicker for AR-15, AR-10 and Glock parts, optics and accessories with today's lowest price and stock. Give a query ("bcm upper 14.5", "holosun 507c"), a category, or both. Returns up to 10 products with a GunPartPicker link; call get_prices for every store's price and a buy link.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Every store's price and stock today for up to 5 products, cheapest in stock first, each with a buy_url that opens that store's listing. Pass product ids or slugs from search_products, or GunPartPicker product URLs.

tools.name: check_build
tools.description: Check that a list of parts fits together (caliber, AR-15 vs AR-10, gas system, thread pitch, handguard mount) the way the GunPartPicker builder does, and price the total. Returns problems per part and one build_url that opens the whole build on GunPartPicker. Up to 20 parts, as slugs or product URLs

tools.name: cheapest_ammo
tools.description: The cheapest ammo in stock today for a caliber, ranked by cost per round with the store's estimated shipping added in, each with a buy_url. Calibers like "9mm", "5.56 NATO", ".223 Rem", ".300 Blackout", "12 Gauge", ".22 LR".

tools.name: find_ffl_dealers
tools.description: Licensed FFL dealers near a US ZIP code that a gun bought online can ship to: the ones with a known transfer fee first, cheapest fee first, then by distance, with address and phone. Set nfa_only for dealers who handle suppressors and SBRs (SOT).

tools.name: gun_laws
tools.description: What a US state's gun laws say, the way the GunPartPicker gun law pages put it: clear, caution or restricted, with the detail, the state's own notes and the statute. Give a state alone for every topic at a glance, or a state and a topic for the full answer. Topics: overview (Overall), assault-weapon

tools.name: check_gun_travel
tools.description: Check a drive or flight between two US states with a firearm: every state on the route, what each one says about what you are bringing (clear, caution or stop), what to do before you cross, and safer routes when one exists. The same check as the GunPartPicker gun travel checker. Items: pistol (Carry
